_comment: THERMAL HEIGHTS tileset probe. Not a level -- it lives in tests/fixtures/ so LevelLoader.list_levels() never sees it, and it is deliberately one screen. Its job is to be the smallest artefact that exercises every role character data/level_legend.json binds for the 'heights' world (ids 240-251) plus the two shared drafts ('U' 206 updraft, '*' 207 updraft_strong), so tests/test_tileset_probes.gd can prove the tileset resolves, its flags survive a level round-trip and the updraft vectors arrive intact. The ruins probe (tests/fixtures/ruins_probe.json) is the same idea for World 2.
_comment_layout: The declared route walks the floor and climbs the chain, and tools/prove.sh plays it. Everything that is a wall to the prover is kept off that line on purpose, which is also the note for the level authors: the shell ('c') is a wall because the prover carries no weapon, the vents ('^') prune every state that touches them, and a one-tile updraft column standing on the floor is a wall too -- the human cannot walk through 400 px/s of lift any more than she can walk into a current (MEMORY: 'a current is a wall for the human'). The shaft here therefore rises out of a vent in the right-hand corner, past the end of the route, and the shell is set in the ledge overhead.
name: HEIGHTS PROBE
